title: Chink Martin
summary: Chink Martin is very old, played with Sharkey, the Rhythm Kings and Almerico.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And was Chink Martin still holding up? He was one of the oldest. He's very old.
Old Chink's very old. I think at least seventy-five now, at least.
He played with Sharky quite a while. He played with a lot of the bands. I mean he played with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings. The Halfway House.
He was with Tony Almarico for a while. When I was down here during the war I heard him.
I guess it was after the war.
Well Chink was very active for a long time. He played with all the best bands around town.
He had some talent around him in his day.
He's played through a lot of talent.
